nodes.description: Private admin address of RootChainlink; the sole authority for upgrades and admin rotation.
Constructor taking the initial admin address and registering it via _setAdmin.
External admin-only function that upgrades the proxy to a new implementation address.
External admin-only function that rotates the admin address.
Internal helper that writes the admin address into storage.
Admin address argument of the constructor.
New implementation address argument forwarded to upgradeTo.
New admin address argument passed to _setAdmin.
Admin address argument assigned to the _admin state variable.
Caller-supplied address used for the onlyAdmin authorization check and in the receive event.
Access-control guard requiring msg.sender to equal the stored _admin before privileged execution.
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the ERC-1967 implementation address; read and written via assembly.
Public virtual initializer invoked through delegatecall during an upgrade.
Public view returning the implementation address by sload of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Internal upgrade routine: stores the new implementation then delegatecalls its initialize() and requires success.
Internal routine validating the target is a contract and sstore-ing it into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Payable receive hook emitting a ValueReceived event with msg.sender and msg.value.
Payable fallback performing delegatecall to the stored implementation with raw calldata.
Address of the implementation being installed, used as delegatecall target.
Address of the implementation being validated and stored.
Local copy of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT used for the sload.
Local copy of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT used for the sstore.
Boolean delegatecall result checked by require.
Revert-data buffer returned by the delegatecall and cast to a string on failure.
Implementation address read from storage and used as delegatecall target.
Arbitrary delegatecall to the stored implementation with user-supplied calldata; executes untrusted code in proxy storage context.
Delegatecall of initialize() on the new implementation during upgrade, executing untrusted code in proxy context.
Raw assembly sstore writing the implementation address into the ERC-1967 slot.
Raw assembly sload reading the implementation address from the ERC-1967 slot.
Library view helper returning whether an account has non-zero extcodesize.
Address whose code size is inspected.
Local holding the extcodesize result before the > 0 comparison.
Assembly extcodesize call used to decide if a target is a contract; unreliable during construction.

edges.reason: Constructor consumes the admin parameter.
Constructor forwards the admin parameter into _setAdmin.
_setAdmin consumes its admin parameter.
_setAdmin writes the admin value into state variable _admin.
implement consumes the implementation parameter.
implement forwards the new implementation address to upgradeTo.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is compared against _admin in the onlyAdmin check.
Stored _admin is the reference value of the onlyAdmin authorization check.
onlyAdmin guard gates execution of implement.
onlyAdmin guard gates execution of setAdmin.
setAdmin consumes the new admin parameter.
setAdmin calls the internal _setAdmin helper.
The new admin argument flows from setAdmin into _setAdmin.
receive() uses msg.sender when emitting ValueReceived.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the slot read by the assembly sload.
Local slot copy is consumed by the sload operation.
implementation() executes the assembly sload.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the slot written by the assembly sstore.
Local slot copy is consumed by the sstore operation.
setImplementation consumes the newImplementation address parameter.
setImplementation performs the raw sstore of the implementation slot.
The newImplementation address is the value written by the sstore.
upgradeTo consumes the newImplementation parameter.
The new implementation address is the delegatecall target.
upgradeTo calls setImplementation before the delegatecall.
upgradeTo executes the delegatecall to initialize().
The delegatecall result is captured in the success local.
The delegatecall revert data is captured in the reason local.
setImplementation gates storage writes behind the isContract validation library call.
isContract consumes the account parameter.
isContract executes the extcodesize assembly operation.
The account address is the argument of extcodesize.
extcodesize result is assigned to the local size variable.
Local size is compared against zero to produce the boolean return value.
fallback() reads the implementation address via implementation().
The implementation address returned is stored into the _impl local.
fallback() performs the delegatecall to the implementation.
The _impl address is the delegatecall target in fallback.
The delegatecalled implementation executes arbitrary code in proxy context and can re-enter the payable receive() hook.
The delegatecall during upgrade invokes initialize() and can re-enter proxy entry points before the upgrade completes.
